name: Minecraft Backrooms Found Footage
storyline:
Suffocating yourself in any way for long enough will eventually cause you to noclip into the backrooms, where you have to travel through all 5 levels to escape:

Level 0 ---------------------- The backrooms we all know and love
Level 1 ---------------------- The Habitable Zone
Level 2 ---------------------- Pipe Dreams
The Poolrooms -------------- The Poolrooms O.o
The Infinite Grass Field ----- This one's different
summary: Minecraft Found Footage is a mod that aims to bring the feeling and aesthetic of "Found Footage" videos to Minecraft
